name: Zacharia Horn-Axe
dmNotes: Wants to find his father and rescue him.

sections.title: Early Life
sections.text: Has no memories of his life before he was six. His first memory is of his father, Brennan Horn-Axe, taking him to the Church of Sargonnas in Maelgoth. His father told him that paladins of Paladine tried to abduct him to torture him for humanity's sins. He was encouraged to embrace the teachings of Sargonnas and when he was 18 he pledged his allegiance to Sargonnas: to get vengeance for those who needed it, show no mercy. He was apprenticed to a wood elf healer named Brynn. One day they were attacked and Brynn was killed. Brennan held off the attackers and told Zacharias to run, and find Ispin.

sections.title: Secrets
sections.text:
The Parents
Zacharias and Darrett's parents were minor, low-profile believers of Paladine. Years ago — well before the current war — someone took an interest in Zacharias specifically: a latent divine connection to Paladine was noticed and flagged as something to be acquired or neutralized.

The Separation
Sensing danger, the parents attempted to get both boys to safety separately, reducing the chance both could be caught at once. Darrett, the younger child, was taken to Vogler first and left there, eventually growing up under Mayor Raven and then Becklin's care after being "abandoned" at age twelve (per existing campaign canon). Before the parents could similarly secure Zacharias, he was intercepted and taken. The people who took him never found Darrett — the plan worked for one son at the cost of the other.

The parents are dead, killed shortly after the separation — likely by the same people pursuing the children, or by the general dangers of the world at the time. They never had the chance to return for either boy. Darrett has spent a decade believing he was abandoned; the truth is closer to the opposite.

Who Took Zacharias, and Why
Zacharias was taken not by the Dragon Army, but by agents of the Church of Sargonnas itself, operating a quiet, doctrinal practice of identifying and acquiring children with unusual latent divine potential — recruiting or neutralizing future threats/assets before they could mature into anything dangerous to the church or useful to a rival faith. This is older than the current war and unrelated to it; it's an unsettling, mundane practice the church has likely done before.

Brennan's Role
Brennan was the operative sent to retrieve Zacharias — not as an obvious threat, but as someone who could get close to the family without alarm. He was already entangled with the church in a lesser capacity at the time. This frames Brennan as compromised and complicit, but not purely a villain — paving the way for the genuinely complicated, abuse-survivor-like relationship the player has already established (Brennan is loving and cruel in turns).

The Necklace
The broken necklace Brennan gave Zacharias is bonded to him as described in the player's original backstory (heartbeat fades if Brennan dies) — that promise to the player remains intact. Additionally, unknown to anyone yet, Darrett holds the matching half. Proximity between the two halves causes a subtle quickening, currently to be gated behind escalating Perception DCs (~18 at range/same room, ~15 at close proximity, automatic on direct contact) so the reveal stays on the DM's pacing rather than surfacing immediately.

Brennan's Current Abduction (Present Day)
The unrecognized banner belongs to a deniable mercenary/scout unit operating on behalf of the Red Dragon Army, consistent with how Dragon Army intelligence (e.g., Lohzet's pattern of disguise and infiltration) has been quietly surveying Maelgoth and greater Solamnia. In the course of this surveillance, they uncovered the hidden Sargonnas church and found records of the memory-suppression working performed on Zacharias — an unusual enough magical event to flag as valuable intelligence. They took Brennan to extract what he knows, both about the church and about where Zacharias is now.

Ispin's Connection
Ispin recognized the banner because he'd plausibly crossed paths with these same scout/mercenary units while quietly tracking Dragon Army movement near Vogler — the same activity that drew Kansaldi's attention and led to his murder. His promised "contacts" to investigate the banner died with him, but the thread remains live through Becklin and whoever Ispin may have already reached out to.
